title: Autumn
text: New members learn suspended bridge design, and the chapter receives its site assignment and writes the Concept Definition Report for the first review call.

title: Winter
text: We design the bridge, teach AutoCAD to new members, and prepare the Design Report for the second review call.

title: Spring
text: We write a detailed construction and logistics plan, prepare the Construction and Safety Report for the third review call, and choose the travel team.

title: Summer
text: Two to four members travel to Bolivia to build the bridge with the community, and they write the Post-Travel Report for the final review call.
